jobgether-jobgether:lever:ab191f03-cbb8-.title: Brand & Content Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:ab191f03-cbb8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Design & Engineering Coordinator based in the United States. This role supports senior design and engineering leadership across a concurrent, multi-project portfolio. You will coordinate design reviews, document control, standards governance, vendor processes, and project workflows. The position requires hands-on ownership of drawings, specifications, submittals, RFIs, compliance trackers, and review documentation. You will help keep multidisciplinary teams aligned, ensuring deliverables, comments, and action items move forward on schedule. The role combines technical project coordination with executive support in a fast-paced, detail-driven environment. Your work will directly improve document accuracy, review efficiency, communication, and project execution across multiple teams and time zones. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, technically fluent, and comfortable driving follow-through without constant supervision. Maintain project document structures, file naming conventions, revision controls, access permissions, and confidentiality requirements across SharePoint and project management platforms. Log, distribute, and track drawing sets, specifications, submittals, RFIs, and design review comments, ensuring receipt, response, and closure are properly documented. Issue and archive transmittals and maintain current-revision registers to prevent teams from working with superseded documentation. Track design review cycles against stage-gate milestones and proactively identify slipping deliverables before they affect project schedules. Maintain compliance and deviation logs, including OPR versus BOD tracking, RFI logs, and bid comparison matrices. Assemble internal and tenant-facing review packages, including consolidated comment logs and response tracking. Coordinate multidisciplinary and multi-time-zone design reviews, workshops, project kickoffs, and knowledge-transfer sessions. Prepare meeting agendas, capture accurate minutes, and maintain action registers with clearly assigned owners and deadlines. Drive action items through completion and escalate stalled deliverables or unresolved issues when necessary. Support RFP and bid processes through distribution, bidder Q&A tracking, proposal intake, and comparison workbook preparation. Onboard consultants and vendors to document platforms, file structures, and naming standards. Maintain consultant contact registers, scopes of work, design team organization charts, and related project information. Track candidate pipelines and interview scheduling for design and engineering positions. Maintain, update, and version-control design standards, checklists, and templates, ensuring current materials are published and accessible to project teams. Manage complex calendars across multiple time zones, including travel arrangements and itinerary coordination. Prepare presentations, expense reports, correspondence, and other materials required by design and engineering leadership. Within the first 90 days, establish consistent document structures, accurate action registers, reliable revision control, and a well-organized executive review queue across active projects. Requirements: 5+ years of experience supporting engineering, architecture, construction, data center development, or similar technical project teams. Demonstrated experience with document control on active design or construction projects. Working knowledge of drawing sets, specification sections, submittal and RFI workflows, and design-phase deliverables such as SD, DD, CD, and IFC. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and SharePoint. Experience with at least one AEC or construction technology platform, such as Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud/BIM 360, Newforma, Sitetracker, Bluebeam Revu, or an equivalent solution. Exceptional organizational skill

jobgether-jobgether:lever:af1d0f39-5cb7-.title: Integration Specialist III
jobgether-jobgether:lever:af1d0f39-5cb7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Integration Specialist III based in the United States. This is a full-time remote opportunity focused on delivering complex healthcare data integration projects with a high degree of ownership. You will help connect healthcare data across platforms and client systems, supporting reliable data flows and successful implementations. The role combines interface development, troubleshooting, data analysis, issue resolution, and integration optimization. You will work with internal teams and clients to solve technical challenges and improve integration workflows from implementation through go-live. Your expertise will contribute to technology solutions that improve healthcare operations, data connectivity, and the patient experience. The environment is collaborative and fast-moving, with opportunities to work independently while contributing to multiple projects and broader team initiatives. This position is well suited to a detail-oriented integration professional who enjoys solving problems and working with healthcare data. Execute complex interface and integration projects with limited guidance, taking ownership of implementation activities through completion. Organize, manage, and drive issue resolution and optimization efforts across assigned projects and programs. Support healthcare data exchange using technologies and formats such as HL7, FHIR/API, X12, flat files, and XML. Use Rhapsody Interface Engine or equivalent interface-engine technology to develop, support, troubleshoot, and optimize data flows. Investigate and resolve client integration issues by applying knowledge of business workflows and interface data flows. Apply data extraction, validation, basic coding, and SQL/query skills to support implementations and integration improvements. Collaborate with internal teams, project stakeholders, and clients to identify opportunities for process and workflow improvements. Support client go-lives outside standard business hours when required and participate in periodic on-call coverage. Contribute to initiatives across Deployment or Development teams and support broader organizational goals when opportunities arise. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree with at least 2 years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience. Experience using Rhapsody Interface Engine or another comparable interface-engine platform. Strong understanding of data and data extraction solutions. Basic programming or scripting capabilities using technologies such as JavaScript, C++, SQL, or equivalent. Foundational knowledge of healthcare data exchange standards, including HL7, FHIR/API, X12, flat files, and XML. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly, ask effective questions, participate in meetings, and deliver concise training. Strong attention to detail, including the ability to review written materials, present numerical information effectively, and adapt communication to different audiences. Ability to manage and prioritize responsibilities across multiple projects and programs simultaneously. Comfortable working independently while also collaborating effectively within a team environment. Willingness to participate in on-call coverage for approximately one week at a time several times per year. Willingness to provide after-hours support when required for client go-lives. Preferred: Orion Rhapsody Associate-level certification or equivalent training. Preferred: Basic understanding of workflows across the technology stack and experience contributing to innovative, collaborative environments. Demonstrated openness to different perspectives, constructive feedback, shared accountability, and team-oriented problem solving. Benefits: Base salary range of $50,461–$142,643.10 per year , with individual compensation base

The role will support the definition and execution of the CRM strategy, including campaign planning, performance monitoring, and results optimization. The candidate will be responsible for designing and managing campaigns across multiple communication channels such as Email, SMS, Web Push, and App Notifications.
